policy: append (delivered = head[:12] + tail[:R]); paired hit loss is 0 by construction, so the only question is rescued-vs-control
control: head_widen at the same R (plain widening, zero code)

decision_rule.PASS_TO_BED: at the single (R,D) cell chosen on the FIT half, held-out rescued - head_widen rescued >= +5
decision_rule.note: +5 is an effect-size bar, not a significance claim

head_basis: map12 (the #430-fixed counterfactual: head[:12] of the shipped score map)
